evidence.quoted_text:
"boot_id_changed": (
            bool(reboot.get("boot_id_before"))
            and bool(reboot.get("boot_id_after"))
            and reboot.get("boot_id_before") != reboot.get("boot_id_after")),
evidence.reason: The reboot check only compares the poll's boot_id_before/after values and never binds them to the before/after snapshots that supply the mask and run-log evidence. A changed poll ID can therefore coexist with stale final snapshots, allowing the report to verify without proving the inspected post-reboot state came from a new boot. The fix is to require each poll ID to equal its corresponding snapshot boot ID, while retaining the distinct/nonempty check.
